cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I changed the meeting time. Did you change the room?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yes. That's my half of why nobody met.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I should have. Now tell me where your half of the meeting went.

mechanism: A uses its own incremental scheduling admissions as a teaching demonstration that pressures its former organizer pupil to supply the missing room change.
confusable: Not simply confessing and asking unrelated information: each A admission narrows the shared failure until B room decision is positioned as the missing half.
comparison: Failed meeting coordination versus concealed complaint correspondence.
seedUse: D232 time change/room/nobody met/why not tell/other half; S05 announcing changes.
